scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run check:architecture && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:macos: swift build --build-system native --package-path apps/macos && swift run --build-system native --skip-build --package-path apps/macos SillageCoreTests && swift run --build-system native --skip-build --package-path apps/macos SillageAudioTests && swift run --build-system native --skip-build --package-path apps/macos SillageServerTests
scripts.verify: npm run verify:node && npm run verify:macos
scripts.verify:node: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:macos: npm run test:packaging && npm run test:macos && npm run test:macos:agents
